article.title: Sir David Attenborough - Blue Planet
paragraphs: Probably most famous nowadays (27).................... the series Blue Planet, Attenborough has made viewers wake up not only to the beauty of our planet, but to the danger we have put it in. After being delighted (28).................... the wonderful photography and Attenborough’s well-known way of keeping us fixed to our TV screens, the final episode showed us the reality. We saw the pollution of our seas and the damage that (29).................... is doing to the sea creatures affected by the rubbish, which is now everywhere. It caused (30).................... a shock that promises of change were quickly made by the government.

Attenborough has an amazing ability to influence public opinion. He argues that with fifty percent of the total population living in cities, people (31).................... to be shown nature, even on TV, as they are not connected to it anymore. Only (32)...................., in his opinion, can we persuade people to take care of it.

questions.label: Câu 29
questions.hint: 💡 The pronoun refers back to 'the pollution'.

questions.label: Câu 30
questions.hint: 💡 Structure: such + a/an + adjective + noun + that-clause.

questions.label: Câu 31
questions.hint: 💡 Necessity: people ___ to be shown nature.

questions.label: Câu 32
questions.hint: 💡 Fixed phrase: 'Only ___ can we...' meaning only after that.

explanation.key: for: đúng vì collocation là 'be famous for something'.
by: đúng vì 'be delighted by something' diễn tả bị/được làm cho rất hài lòng; câu đang dùng passive voice và tác nhân được giới thiệu bằng 'by'.
it: đại từ này thay cho 'the pollution' đã được nhắc ngay trước đó: 'the damage that it is doing...'.
such: cấu trúc đúng là 'such + a/an + adjective + noun + that-clause': 'such a shock that...'.
have: 'have to' diễn tả sự cần thiết. Sau đó là passive infinitive 'to be shown'.
then: cụm 'only then' nghĩa là chỉ sau khi điều vừa nói xảy ra thì việc tiếp theo mới có thể xảy ra.
